Image.Title: Carousel image
Image.Hint: Custom image for {name} in the combat carousel. Cut-out full-body art (PNG or WebP with a transparent background) looks best.

TimerEnabled.Name: Enable turn timer
TimerEnabled.Hint: Shows a countdown below the active character. Can also be toggled on the carousel via the small hourglass at the bottom right (GM only).

TimerSeconds.Name: Turn timer: seconds per turn
TimerSeconds.Hint: How long a turn may take.

TimerScope.Name: Turn timer applies to
TimerScope.Hint: Whether the timer runs only for player characters or for NPCs too.

TimerExpire.Name: When the turn timer runs out
TimerExpire.Hint: Only show it, or end the turn automatically.

AnnounceTurn.Name: Large turn announcement
AnnounceTurn.Hint: On every turn change, everyone briefly sees the text and the image of the character whose turn it is.

AnnounceText.Name: Turn announcement text
AnnounceText.Hint: {name} is replaced with the name, e.g. "{name}'s Turn". If the name is hidden from players, ??? is shown.

AllowPlayerMove.Name: Players may move the carousel
AllowPlayerMove.Hint: If enabled, each player can move the carousel for themselves. Otherwise everyone uses the GM's position.

MaxSlots.Name: Visible characters
MaxSlots.Hint: Maximum number of characters shown at once. With more combatants the carousel scrolls along.

PrevCount.Name: Already acted (left)
PrevCount.Hint: How many characters stay to the left of the active character.

ImageSource.Name: Image source
ImageSource.Hint: Which image is shown when no custom carousel image is set (right-click a figure in the carousel).

Show.Name: Show combat carousel
Show.Hint: Just for you: show or hide the carousel.

ShowAnnounce.Name: Show large turn announcement
ShowAnnounce.Hint: Just for you: see the large announcement on turn changes (if the GM enabled it).

Scale.Name: Carousel size (%)
Scale.Hint: Just for you: how large the carousel and the announcements are drawn.

NextBanner.Name: "You're up next" notice
NextBanner.Hint: Just for you: large notice when your character is next in line.

Sound.Name: Notification sound
Sound.Hint: Just for you: short sound with the "You're up next" notice.
